question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution:
The correct answer is **"Appearanse". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Appearanse" **word is incorrectly spelled.
 
• The correct spelling should be **"appearance". **
 
• Appearance refers to the way that someone or something looks. (जिस तरह से कोई व्यक्ति या वस्तु दिखती है)
 
 
• **For example, **"*She always takes great care in her appearance before stepping out.*"
 
 

From the above explanation, it is clear that the correct answer is **Option 1. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Appropriate** means suitable or proper in the circumstances. (परिस्थिति में उपयुक्त या उचित)
 
• **Apparatus **refers to a complex structure within an organization or system or a set of equipment or tools used for a specific purpose. (किसी संगठन या प्रणाली के भीतर एक जटिल संरचना या किसी विशिष्ट उद्देश्य के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले उपकरणों या उपकरणों का एक सेट)
 
• To **appreciate **something means to recognize the full worth or value of it or to be grateful for it. (इसके पूर्ण मूल्य या मूल्य को पहचानना या इसके लिए आभारी होना)
